english.note: Use 𧕴 specifically for the swelling or mark caused by an insect bite, especially a mosquito bite.

exampleSentences.english: I’ve got a mosquito bite on my leg.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我隻腳畀蚊叮到起咗個𧕴。
